name: Safe Known Regression Rollback
description: Allow automatic rollback when high-confidence known regression detected with low blast radius

name: Medium Confidence Requires Approval
description: Require human approval when confidence is moderate or blast radius is significant

name: High Blast Radius Always Requires Approval
description: High or critical blast radius always requires human approval

name: Low Confidence Deny
description: Deny actions when confidence is below 40%

name: Default Incident Policy
description: Default policy for incident management — always require approval
